title: SLP99 Pressure Switch Lockout (E223 / E227 / E271 / E272)
description: Work a low-pressure-switch fault on an SLP99UHVK from the vent and inducer through to the operating pressure signal, using TABLE 39 of the Service Manual.
safety_notes: Turn power off at the disconnect before opening the heating compartment; the unit may have more than one power supply.
Do not adjust the pressure switches or the gas valve; they are factory set.
If gas is smelled at any point, stop, shut the gas valve, and call the gas supplier from outside.

steps.title: Confirm the code
steps.instruction: Hold the diagnostic button until a solid E shows and release it to enter Error Code Recall. Which code is in the history: E223, E227, E271, or E272, or a high-switch code E225 or E226?

steps.title: Check the exhaust and intake
steps.instruction: Inspect the exhaust and combustion-air intake pipes and their terminations for blockage, and check the connections are tight. Confirm the condensate trap is primed and draining. Is anything blocked or loose?

branches.condition: A blockage or loose joint was found
Vent, intake and trap are clear

steps.title: Check the pressure switch tubing
steps.instruction: With power off, compare the four tubes to FIGURE 65: black from the low-fire switch front port to the gas valve positive port; red-and-black from the low-fire switch rear port to the gas valve negative port; red-and-black from the high-fire switch front port to the cold end header box negative port; black from the high-fire switch rear port to the header box positive port. Any tube kinked, split, wet, or on the wrong port?
steps.expected_input: tubing correct or a problem found
steps.safety_note: Power off at the disconnect before opening the heating compartment.

branches.condition: A tube is damaged, wet, or misrouted

steps.title: Measure the operating pressure signal
steps.instruction: Tee a manometer into the negative and positive lines between the gas valve and the pressure switch. Restore power, run low heat for 5 minutes, and read the operating pressure signal; then repeat on high heat. Tell me both readings in inches of water column.
steps.expected_input: low-fire and high-fire Delta P readings

branches.condition: Low 0.20 to 0.40 (0.15 to 0.35 on the 090XV60C) and high 0.95 to 1.25
Either reading outside the TABLE 39 range

steps.title: Inducer and heat exchanger
steps.instruction: The signal is low, so the inducer is not moving enough air. Check the combustion air inducer for amp draw, bearing noise and wheel condition (E294 is the inducer over-current code), and inspect the cold end header box and secondary heat exchanger for condensate or debris. Report what you find.

steps.title: Switch or calibration suspected
steps.instruction: The pressure signal is within range, so suspect the switch itself or its calibration. Run a vent calibration from Field Test mode: hold the button until a solid C shows and release; the control displays CAL while it calibrates both switches. If the code returns with the signal still in range, the pressure switch is failing and is replaced as a factory-set part; do not adjust it.

steps.title: Correct, clear and retest
steps.instruction: Correct what you found, restore power, and run a full heat cycle on low and high fire. Clear the error history with c in Error Code Recall only after the retest passes, so the record stays for the report.

steps.title: Different fault
steps.instruction: This procedure covers the pressure switch codes only. Look up the code shown in error_codes.md and follow its row instead.
